senses.gloss: f. (פטר, Nif. נִפְטַר to part; v. הַפְטָרָה)
farewell-address, homiletic observations made on parting with the host that entertained scholars, toast (in praise of hospitality, charity, support of students &c.).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:7">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> R. Y. <he>עבד לה א׳</he> used the (preceding) text for a toast; a. fr.
